display.purpose: Catalog numbers in section headers. Width axis 125%.

caps.purpose: Every label, button and section name. Width 115%.

readout.purpose: Values in the transmission data list. Width 112%, uppercase.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Thumb and colour flicks. 0 under reduced motion.

motion.name: t-mid
motion.purpose: Hover, toggles, button blocks. 0 under reduced motion.

motion.name: t-slow
motion.purpose: Rail marker, view fly-in, segment indicator. 0 under reduced motion.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Primary action. Plot-white hairline with a red block set into the right edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 38px; padding: 0 34px 0 16px; border: 1px solid #f2f2f2; border-radius: 0; background: none; color: #f2f2f2; overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; font-stretch: 115%; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-block { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 26px; background: #e2372c; transform: scaleX(0.6923); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover .ds-btn-block { transform: none; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #f2f2f2; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Seam-2 hairline, quiet text that brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #3d3d3d; border-radius: 0; background: none; color: #a8a8a8; transition: color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; font-stretch: 115%; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #f2f2f2; border-color: #8a8a8a; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #f2f2f2; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Catalog Rail
components.description: Section navigation: code plus engraved label, an outlined box marks the active entry, its code in red.
components.css: .ds-rail { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 12px; display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 196px; background: #0b0b0b; } .ds-rail button { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: none; color: #8a8a8a; text-align: left; transition: color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; font-stretch: 115%; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rail button:hover { color: #a8a8a8; } .ds-rail button[aria-current] { color: #f2f2f2; border-color: #f2f2f2; } .ds-code { font-size: 12px; font-stretch: 112%; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-rail button[aria-current] .ds-code { color: #e2372c; } .ds-rail button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #f2f2f2; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Catalog Cells
components.description: Segmented choice: hairline cells with codes; the active cell is outlined in white with a red edge block.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; border: 1px solid #3d3d3d; background: #0b0b0b; } .ds-seg button { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid #3d3d3d; background: none; color: #8a8a8a; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; font-stretch: 115%; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-seg button:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #a8a8a8; } .ds-seg .ds-c { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #5c5c5c; } .ds-seg [aria-checked=true] { color: #f2f2f2; outline: 1px solid #f2f2f2; outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-seg [aria-checked=true] .ds-c { color: #e2372c; } .ds-seg [aria-checked=true]::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 5px; background: #e2372c; }

components.name: Slider
components.description: Hairline track, 3px tick thumb that turns red while dragged; label and readout above.
components.css: .ds-slider { display: grid; gap: 10px; width: 260px; color: #f2f2f2; } .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-row span { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; font-stretch: 115%; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a8a8a8; } .ds-row output { font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-slider input { appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 18px; background: linear-gradient(#f2f2f2,#f2f2f2) 0 50%/72% 1px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#3d3d3d,#3d3d3d) 0 50%/100% 1px no-repeat; } .ds-slider input::-webkit-slider-thumb { appearance: none; width: 3px; height: 18px; background: #f2f2f2; transition: background 160ms; } .ds-slider input:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { background: #e2372c; } .ds-slider input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #f2f2f2; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Hairline rectangle with a sliding square; the square turns red when on.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; border: 0; background: none; color: #a8a8a8; } .ds-state { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; font-stretch: 115%; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-track { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 18px; border: 1px solid #3d3d3d; } .ds-knob { position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 10px; height: 10px; background: #5c5c5c; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 260ms; } .ds-toggle[aria-checked=true] .ds-track { border-color: #f2f2f2; } .ds-toggle[aria-checked=true] .ds-knob { transform: translateX(20px); background: #e2372c; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #f2f2f2; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Code Strip
components.description: A device's live colours as a row of blocks; seam grey when the device is away.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; gap: 3px; width: 200px; height: 10px; } .ds-strip i { background: #3d3d3d; transition: background-color 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); }

narrative.overview:
uncoil looks like a record sleeve from an industrial label: matte black, ruled hairlines, wide engraved capitals, and every object filed under a catalog number. The lighting engine is the record. The app is its sleeve, and the sleeve's job is to print what the engine is doing with the precision of a spec sheet.

The world lends the app four things only: its palette, its lettering, its density, and one signature move (the pulse plot). Controls stay standard controls; the world dresses them in hairlines and catalog codes but never disguises them.

Colour is code. The interface itself is monochrome; the four FAC hues mark state (red is live and active, yellow is a warning, blue and grey are reserved), and real LED colour appears only where the app is decoding something the devices are actually showing.
keyCharacteristics: Matte near-black ground with plot-white ink and four grey steps for hierarchy
One-pixel hairline rules in place of cards, shadows, or fills
Every section and option carries a catalog code (FAC 101, 201, 02)
Wide variable grotesk: wide and light for display numerals, wide and tracked caps for labels
Motion is a single expo-out curve; nothing bounces except the dial needle

rules.name: The Colour Is Code Rule
rules.body: A hue appears only when it means something: red for live or active, yellow for trouble. Decorative colour is never used. LED colours are data and appear only where they decode real output.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: At most one red mark per control. The active nav item gets a red code, not a red code plus a red border.

rules.name: The Engraved Label Rule
rules.body: Every label is engraved caps: small, wide, and tracked. Sentence case is for prose and hints only.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading. The catalog code and name share one baseline (FAC 200 · DEVICES); the code is the heading.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: If something needs separating, rule it with a 1px line. Never use a fill, a shadow, or a card.

dos: Do give every section, effect, and device a catalog code, and let the code be the heading.
Do separate with 1px hairlines and nothing else.
Do keep red for live, active, or in-hand states, one mark per control.
Do route every transition through the shared expo-out ease and the 160 / 260 / 420 ms steps, and make them zero under reduced motion (JS transitions go through `ms()` in `src/lib/motion.ts`).
Do show real LED colour only where it decodes actual output.
donts: Don't put kicker or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use gradient text, glass, blur, shadows, or rounded corners.
Don't use colour decoratively or invent a fifth hue.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, padding, margin); use `transform` and `opacity`.
Don't name SVG classes after Tailwind utilities (`outline`, `border`, `ring`). Tailwind's rule applies to the SVG element and scales by the viewBox.
Don't imitate Razer's branding, green, or product imagery. uncoil is its own label.
